slides.title: What is the homework?
slides.headline: What is the homework?

panels.heading: Update the plan
panels.support: The growth plan and each leader’s priorities. Add each lane’s steps under its company priority.

panels.heading: KFFM and scorecards
panels.support: Put the KFFM into Metronome. Complete a scorecard for every leader and every direct report.

panels.heading: Core Customer and forecast
panels.support: Update the Market Map and add the Core Customer to the War Room. Finance works the widgets back into this year’s forecast.

panels.heading: Prepare
panels.support: No agreed Core Values? Run Mission to Mars. Your team takes StrengthsFinder 2.0. Read The Five Dysfunctions of a Team. Complete the prep survey.

notes: Also: share the 3 key messages with your team the day after. Keep running all company meetings through Metronome. Add the widget-based company metric, if defined.
Give every item an owner and a date (What, Owner, By When), as on the board’s Homework area.

slides.title: Did we get what we came for?
slides.headline: Did we get what we came for?
slides.support: For each outcome: answered, partly or still open?
notes: Read back the outcomes the team agreed at the start.
Ask for a show of hands on each one.
Still open is fine. Add each open outcome to the homework with an owner and a date.
The sticky shows the coach’s outcome for the session. Ask the team whether it was met, along with their own.

artwork.alt: Byron’s sticky note, handwritten with: Planning and executing with increasing momentum.
